blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY — A total of 2,758 job openings, including overseas employment opportunities, were offered to Boholano job seekers during a campus mega job fair at Holy Name University (HNU) here on Saturday, Nov. 28. The “Tara Trabaho, G?” Local and Overseas Campus Mega Job Fair 2026 was led by the Office of Senate President Win Gatchalian in partnership with the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE), the Public Employment Service Office (PESO), Tagbilaran City government and HNU. Of the total vacancies, 1,032 positions were offered by 19 local companies, while five overseas recruitment agencies listed 1,726 jobs abroad. A total […]...
